title: Dam a Ɛbubuu Ahenni Bi
intro: Asase a nsubɔnten a ɛsen, turo abien a ɛyɛ frɔmfrɔm, ne yiyedi a ɛso bi nni — nanso emufo no yɛɛ anibiannaso wɔ Nea ohyiraa wɔn no ho. Bere a nkaebɔ ahorow bae frɛɛ wɔn san bae no, wɔdanee wɔn ho. Nea edii akyi bae ne asotwe a ɛda so ara ka sɛ kɔkɔbɔ. Henanom ne tete mpɔtam ha yi?
clues: Ná yɛte asase bi a wɔahyira so araa ma na yɛn fie no da turo abien a ɛso yɛ frɔmfrɔm ntam.
Yɛn ani gyee nsubɔnten a ɛsen fa yɛn nsase so ne nnɔbae pii a ɛhyɛ yɛn afie ma no ho.
Nanso bere a wɔfrɛɛ yɛn kɔɔ aseda ne osetie mu ma yɛn Awurade no, yɛde ahantan danee yɛn ho.
Yɛn ahonyade ne ahotɔ a yɛwɔ no maa yɛn werɛ fii Nea ɔmaa ne nyinaa maa yɛn no.
Afei asubɔnten bi a ɛretu mpofirim a ɛbubuu akwanside kɛse a yɛde yɛn ho too so no mu bae.
Yɛyɛ Saba' nkurofoɔ, a na wonim wɔn asase sɛ Ma'rib Dam kɛseɛ no.

arabic: فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَـٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍۢ وَأَثْلٍۢ وَشَىْءٍۢ مِّن سِدْرٍۢ قَلِيلٍۢ
verse: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam, and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees. (34:16)
